Stanley-Laman Group LTD Has Trimmed Tiffany & Co (TIF) Stake; Last Week MSG Networks Inc. (MSGN) Coverage
May 18, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Among 13 analysts covering The Madison Square Garden Company ( NYSE:MSGN ), 4 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 8 Hold. Therefore 31% are positive. The Madison Square Garden Company had 16 analyst reports since September 30, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was upgraded by Stifel Nicolaus on Wednesday, September 30 to “Buy”. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Evercore given on Tuesday, April 11. The firm has “Sector Perform” rating by FBN Securities given on Thursday, May 12. Jefferies initiated MSG Networks Inc. (NYSE:MSGN) rating on Thursday, October 1. Jefferies has “Hold” rating and $20 target. The rating was downgraded by Macquarie Research on Wednesday, April 5 to “Neutral”. Cantor Fitzgerald initiated the shares of MSGN in report on Wednesday, October 7 with “Hold” rating. The stock has “Sell” rating by Loop Capital on Friday, December 16. On Tuesday, January 19 the stock rating was downgraded by Stifel Nicolaus to “Sell”. The stock of MSG Networks Inc. (NYSE:MSGN) has “Hold” rating given on Monday, August 7 by Loop Capital. As per Tuesday, January 31, the company rating was reinitiated by Bank of America. See MSG Networks Inc. (NYSE:MSGN) latest ratings:
Stanley-Laman Group Ltd decreased Tiffany & Co (TIF) stake by 7.14% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Stanley-Laman Group Ltd sold 5,000 shares as Tiffany & Co (TIF)’s stock declined 6.13%. The Stanley-Laman Group Ltd holds 65,000 shares with $6.76M value, down from 70,000 last quarter. Tiffany & Co now has $12.94B valuation. The stock decreased 0.22% or $0.22 during the last trading session, reaching $103.96. About 509,728 shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500.
Among 29 analysts covering Tiffany & Co. ( NYSE:TIF ), 16 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 13 Hold. Therefore 55% are positive. Tiffany & Co. had 90 analyst reports since July 29, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Cowen & Co maintained Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) rating on Friday, August 26. Cowen & Co has “Market Perform” rating and $74 target. RBC Capital Markets maintained the shares of TIF in report on Wednesday, August 16 with “Hold” rating. On Thursday, September 14 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Buy”. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, January 17 by Wells Fargo. On Wednesday, November 29 the stock rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Hold”. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Friday, November 11 by Cowen & Co. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, October 18 by Cowen & Co. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, September 30 by Guggenheim. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Cowen & Co given on Tuesday, April 11. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) on Tuesday, November 21 with “Hold” rating.
More recent Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) news were published by: Seekingalpha.com which released: “How Far Could Tiffany Fall?” on April 25, 2018. Also Streetinsider.com published the news titled: “JANA Shows New Stakes in Apple (AAPL), Boston Scientific (BSX), Dropbox (DBX), iQIYI (IQ) (more..) -13F” on May 15, 2018. Investingnews.com ‘s news article titled: “One of Sierra Leone’s Last Diamond Mines Reopens” with publication date: May 16, 2018 was also an interesting one.
Analysts await Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) to report earnings on May, 23 before the open. They expect $0.84 earnings per share, up 13.51% or $0.10 from last year’s $0.74 per share. TIF’s profit will be $104.58M for 30.94 P/E if the $0.84 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.67 actual earnings per share reported by Tiffany & Co. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -49.70% negative EPS growth.
The stock increased 1.00% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $20.15. About 180,798 shares traded. MSG Networks Inc. (NYSE:MSGN) has risen 2.43% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
MSG Networks Inc. engages in the sports production, and content development and distribution businesses in the United States. The company has market cap of $1.52 billion. The firm owns and operates MSG Network and MSG+, which are regional sports and entertainment networks. It has a 5.43 P/E ratio. It also operates MSG GO that provides live streaming and video on demand, as well as a Website and social media platforms for its brands.
